_readme: Hand-authored once. This is where ALL human judgement about the photographs lives.
crop: [left, top, right, bottom] in source pixels, or null for the whole frame.
ratio: target aspect after cropping toward focus. One of 4:3, 3:4, 16:9. NEVER upscales.
focus: [x, y] in 0..1, the point the aspect crop is taken around.
wb: 0..1 strength of the clamped-percentile white balance. 0 leaves the file alone.
wb_midtone: compute the white reference over midtones only, for casts a global measure cannot see.
Files not listed here are deliberately NOT published. See tools/EXCLUDED.md for the reasons.
